title: Implement POST /api/generate/prospect/[slug] route
description: Create the API route that triggers full AI pipeline generation for a single prospect. Updates prospect status throughout the pipeline and saves page_data on completion.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/generate/prospect/[slug] triggers the full pipeline for one prospect
Prospect status is set to 'processing' immediately
On pipeline completion, page_data is saved and status set to 'ready'
On pipeline failure, status is set to 'failed' with error_message saved
Verify by triggering generation and polling prospect status until complete

steps.details: Export POST handler. Look up prospect by slug. Set status='processing'. Start pipeline in background (do NOT await — return 202 immediately). Use `.then()` and `.catch()` handlers on the pipeline promise.
Return `NextResponse.json({ message: 'Generation started', slug }, { status: 202 })` before the pipeline promise resolves.
POST to endpoint. Verify 202 response. Poll GET /api/prospects/[slug] every 2s until status changes from 'processing' to 'ready' or 'failed'.
